name: Speed-Test
description: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a Free and Open-Source HTML5 Network Performance Estimation Tool Written in Vanilla Javascript and only uses built-in Web APIs like XMLHttpRequest (XHR), HTML, CSS, JS, & SVG. No Third-Party frameworks or libraries are Required. Started in 2011 and moved to OpenSpeedTest.com dedicated Project/Domain Name in 2013.
readme_summary: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a free, open-source HTML5 tool for estimating network performance. Written in vanilla JavaScript, it uses only built-in web APIs and requires no third-party frameworks, making it lightweight and secure. It can be hosted on any static web server.
key_features: Uses only built-in Web APIs (XMLHttpRequest, HTML, CSS, JS, SVG)
No Third-Party frameworks or libraries required
Requires only a static web server (e.g., NGINX)
primary_use_case: To provide a simple, lightweight, and secure way to measure network performance directly from a web browser without requiring any client-side software or plugins.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized speedometer with a digital stream of data flowing into its base. The needle of the speedometer is actively measuring and pointing to a high-performance reading, with glowing blue and green energy radiating upwards. Subtle, abstract representations of network cables and Wi-Fi signals intertwine around the speedometer. In the background, a clean, minimalist interface with a single 'Test Speed' button is visible, hinting at the browser-based nature. The overall mood is dynamic and efficient, using a color palette of blues, greens, and whites. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear, understandable iconography and a polished, modern aesthetic.

name: QtScrcpy
readme_summary: QtScrcpy is a lightweight and high-performance application that allows users to display and control their Android devices on their computers via USB or network connection. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, requires no root access, and focuses on low latency and fast startup times.
key_features: Keyboard and mouse mapping for games and applications
primary_use_case: Mirroring and controlling an Android device's screen on a computer for enhanced productivity, gaming, or presentation purposes.
cover_image_prompt: A split image: on one side, a hand holding a smartphone, with its screen showing a complex, vibrant Android interface. On the other side, a computer monitor displaying the exact same interface, but now being controlled by a keyboard and mouse. A subtle digital bridge, made of glowing data streams, connects the phone to the computer. The computer side has small, stylized UI elements indicating control and low latency. The overall mood is seamless integration and effortless control. The style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a cool color palette.

name: weathr
description: a terminal weather app with ascii animation
readme_summary: Weathr is a terminal-based weather application written in Rust that displays real-time weather information with engaging ASCII animations. It features auto-location detection and customizable display options, providing a visually rich weather experience directly in the command line.
key_features: ASCII animations (rain, snow, thunderstorms, day/night cycles)
Customizable configuration (hide HUD, silent mode, location display)
Multiple installation methods (binary, Cargo, Docker, Homebrew, MacPorts, AUR, Nix, Winget)
primary_use_case: Displaying real-time weather information with animated ASCII art in a terminal environment.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, glowing terminal window floats in a dark, atmospheric void. Inside the terminal, a miniature, animated scene unfolds: gentle rain falls, a sun or moon cycles, and subtle weather icons shift. Around the terminal, ethereal streams of data representing weather patterns flow from a stylized globe towards the screen. The repository name 'weathr' is subtly etched into the side of the terminal. The overall mood is mystical and informative, with a focus on the transformation of raw data into a visually engaging weather display. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, moody color palette and glowing neon accents.

name: Mockoops
description: Create 💎 beautiful animations from boring screen recordings within ⏳ seconds
readme_summary: Mockoops is a JavaScript-based tool that transforms boring screen recordings into beautiful, animated mockups in seconds. It leverages React and serverless functions for fast rendering, offering responsive video templates and long-term caching.
key_features: Superfast rendering powered by Serverless Functions
primary_use_case: Creating animated mockups from screen recordings for presentations, teasers, and product announcements.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artist character with a magic wand, standing in front of a plain, dull screen recording of a software interface. The artist is waving their wand, and from the recording, vibrant, animated elements like glowing borders, zooming effects, and stylized text are emerging, transforming the dull recording into a polished, dynamic video mockup. Small, abstract UI elements and data particles float around the scene, hinting at the underlying technology. The background is a clean, modern studio space. The overall mood is creative and efficient. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with bright, engaging colors and clear visual storytelling.
